phrase: A falta de pan, buenas son tortas
meaning: Half a loaf is better than none
example: "No hay café, pero hay té. A falta de pan, buenas son tortas." (There is no coffee, but there is tea. Half a loaf is better than none.)
"Dije que iría al gimnasio y, dicho y hecho, aquí estoy" (I said I would go to the gym and, said and done, here I am)
"Lleva un paraguas por si acaso llueve" (Take an umbrella just in case it rains)
"Me pidió ayuda y, dicho y hecho, fui a su casa" (He asked me for help and, no sooner said than done, I went to his house)
